svg.text: 1U rack chassis, single board, host-attached. Generated from hw/board.yaml by hw/kicad_gen.py. Blue: ring ribbons on In2.Cu; pink: core-rail islands on In8.Cu. Rear of the chassis at the bottom.

Memory, PCIe and management nets are unrouted. Longest lane per hop: FPGA -> A0 27 mm; A0 -> A1 26 mm; A1 -> A2 26 mm; A2 -> A3 26 mm; A3 -> A4 26 mm; A4 -> A5 26 mm; A5 -> A6 26 mm; A6 -> A7 26 mm; A7 -> H0 26 mm; H0 -> H1 26 mm; H1 -> FPGA 27 mm
